_doc: Catalog of available agent backends. Each entry describes how to authenticate (auth_schema), how the auto-OAuth flow works (auto_flow), and how to verify a captured token (test). Today only claude-code; future codex-cli, gemini, etc. join here. See spec 0071.

backends.name: Claude Code
backends.description: Anthropic's Claude via the official Claude Code OAuth subscription. The dashboard wraps `claude setup-token` for the auto-OAuth flow; the captured token is verified with a single Claude API handshake before being stored encrypted.

auth_schema.label: OAuth token
auth_schema.regex_hint: Tokens start with sk-ant-oat<NN>- and are 60+ chars.
